tasks.behavior: Diagrams stop touching: a branch draws as an outlined diamond that holds its own label, connections keep real clearance from cards and from each other, a workflow column is wide enough for a connection to turn in, a sequence spaces its lifelines to fit the captions between them and its rows to fit the captions they carry, fragment frames cover only the participants their messages touch, a reading stays readable and a click during one ends it, and the header brand opens nothing.
acceptance: A decision's label sits entirely inside its diamond, in the editor and in the SVG export, and the diamond is outlined rather than a solid block.
No caption overlaps another caption, a fragment frame, or a card it does not belong to, across every fixture and every template.
Every routed connection starts and ends on the cards it joins, and a sequence message on its participants' lifelines.
A workflow column gap holds two stubs and a routing channel, and ELK is told how much room a connection needs.
Two ports on the same side of a card are at least one routing channel apart.
A dimmed component during a walk or a run is still readable, and clicking one ends the reading and selects it.
The header brand is not a control, and Export and Open file are in the More menu.
